# `lsan` trace fixtures

Real, unedited sanitizer output (stderr) from already-fixed bugs in public projects. Regenerate with `python scripts/capture_sanitizer_fixtures.py --only lsan`.

- Image: `localhost/nikasha-capture:latest` (ID `sha256:98c5ba2bb2cacff77f0429a56fc6dfe283ac5a0bf244c74bb423f26ff915bc1b`) built from `docker/capture/Containerfile`, base `registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44@sha256:b4488a77fd2b96513fc8c18b502df7fbf19dad9e77d9a430c0163c574654822c`
- Compiler in the image: `clang version 22.1.8 (Fedora 22.1.8-4.fc44)`
- Engine: docker, run through `nikasha.repro.sandbox.run_container`
- Each capture was checked: the fixed tag builds and produces no sanitizer report.

| Fixture | Project | Vulnerable | Fixed | Fix commit | Reference | Environment | Script |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `01-zstd-simple-compression.txt` | https://github.com/facebook/zstd.git | `v1.1.3` (`cbc5225d38ba65a1cd77701e91a9f45f3cc825ba`) | `v1.1.4` (`ebf275912aeb046b9379ec48cfd0e336a542f590`) | `2bb6fc2a944d30d0ec3ec18d3db0fc462cf06ccf` | https://github.com/facebook/zstd/pull/546 | `CC=clang CFLAGS=-fsanitize=leak -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer CXX=clang++ CXXFLAGS=-fsanitize=leak -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer LDFLAGS=-fsanitize=leak LSAN_OPTIONS=exitcode=23` | `cp -r /src/tree /work/tree && cd /work/tree && { ( $CC $CFLAGS -Ilib -Ilib/common examples/simple_compression.c lib/common/*.c lib/compress/*.c -o simple_compression $LDFLAGS ) >/work/build.log 2>&1 \|\| { { grep -m 40 -E 'error\|Error\|No such file\|not found' /work/build.log \| cut -c1-300; echo '--- build log tail ---'; tail -c 2500 /work/build.log; } >&2; exit 125; }; }; for i in $(seq 1 1); do ( cp README.md /work/r.md && ./simple_compression /work/r.md ) >/dev/null 2>/work/out; rc=$?; if grep -qF -- 'ERROR: LeakSanitizer: ' /work/out; then cat /work/out >&2; exit $rc; fi; done; cat /work/out >&2; exit 124` |
| `02-jq-setpath-array-key.txt` | https://github.com/jqlang/jq.git | `jq-1.7.1` (`71c2ab509a8628dbbad4bc7b3f98a64aa90d3297`) | `jq-1.8.0` (`d23a7b9db932be706fecf5f4c9711fd4214bb64e`) | `5bbd02f581dff4060815e4291b80a9316841195e` | https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=66061 | `CC=clang CFLAGS=-fsanitize=leak -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer CXX=clang++ CXXFLAGS=-fsanitize=leak -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer LDFLAGS=-fsanitize=leak LSAN_OPTIONS=exitcode=23` | `cp -r /src/tree /work/tree && cd /work/tree && { ( printf '#!/bin/sh\necho exported\n' > scripts/version && mkdir -p modules/oniguruma vendor/oniguruma && autoreconf -i && ./configure --with-oniguruma=no --disable-docs --disable-shared && make -j4 ) >/work/build.log 2>&1 \|\| { { grep -m 40 -E 'error\|Error\|No such file\|not found' /work/build.log \| cut -c1-300; echo '--- build log tail ---'; tail -c 2500 /work/build.log; } >&2; exit 125; }; }; for i in $(seq 1 1); do ( ./jq -n '[] \| setpath([[1]]; 1)' ) >/dev/null 2>/work/out; rc=$?; if grep -qF -- 'ERROR: LeakSanitizer: ' /work/out; then cat /work/out >&2; exit $rc; fi; done; cat /work/out >&2; exit 124` |
| `03-zstd-recursive-symlink.txt` | https://github.com/facebook/zstd.git | `v1.4.1` (`52181f877a96ca3feb688820ba852a0c044cc620`) | `v1.4.2` (`ff304e9e65e7cde17a637eea190a874c26c48634`) | `793b94b3541de7535787b5ddebc555bc63d9bef3` | https://github.com/facebook/zstd/pull/1701 | `CC=clang CFLAGS=-fsanitize=leak -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer CXX=clang++ CXXFLAGS=-fsanitize=leak -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer LDFLAGS=-fsanitize=leak LSAN_OPTIONS=exitcode=23` | `cp -r /src/tree /work/tree && cd /work/tree && { ( make -C programs zstd HAVE_ZLIB=0 HAVE_LZMA=0 HAVE_LZ4=0 ) >/work/build.log 2>&1 \|\| { { grep -m 40 -E 'error\|Error\|No such file\|not found' /work/build.log \| cut -c1-300; echo '--- build log tail ---'; tail -c 2500 /work/build.log; } >&2; exit 125; }; }; for i in $(seq 1 1); do ( rm -rf /work/d && mkdir /work/d && cp README.md /work/d/r.md && ln -s r.md /work/d/link && ./programs/zstd -q -r /work/d ) >/dev/null 2>/work/out; rc=$?; if grep -qF -- 'ERROR: LeakSanitizer: ' /work/out; then cat /work/out >&2; exit $rc; fi; done; cat /work/out >&2; exit 124` |
